info.name: PMS Backend (Triponx)
info.description:
Every endpoint in the PMS backend, grouped by area.

Order: run Auth (Login), then Setup to fill IDs, then the rest.

- Sign-in is email and password only. There is no MFA step.
- Seeded accounts (password Password@123, from `npm run db:seed`): admin@pms.local (Hotel Admin), gm@, fdm@, fde@, hkm@, hks@, auditor@, accountant@, rates@ and nightlead@ (all @pms.local); super@pms.local (platform); owner@coastal.local (Coastal Stays, Goa property).
- PATCH and check-in/out send If-Match from the record ETag captured in Setup.
- Requests that change state (check-in, payments, cancellations) may conflict on a second run. That is expected.
- The test script only asserts that no response is a 5xx. Read each response body yourself.
